achievements.label: First Contact
achievements.description: Finish any puzzle, win or lose.

achievements.label: Clean Signal
achievements.description: Win using no more pings than the puzzle's par.

achievements.label: Under Par
achievements.description: Win using fewer pings than par.

achievements.label: Lucky Guess
achievements.description: Commit the right answer with 4 or more pings unused.

achievements.label: Three in a Row
achievements.description: Win the daily puzzle 3 days running in one mode.

achievements.label: Week on Air
achievements.description: Win the daily puzzle 7 days running in one mode.

achievements.label: Month on Air
achievements.description: Win the daily puzzle 30 days running in one mode.

achievements.label: Both Bands
achievements.description: Win the Easy and Hard daily puzzles on the same UTC day.

achievements.label: Static
achievements.description: Lose a puzzle. Everyone loses one.

achievements.label: Overlap
achievements.description: Ping a tile whose reading is stronger than any single transmitter can give.

achievements.label: Silent Night
achievements.description: Get three zero readings in one puzzle.

achievements.label: Puzzle #100
achievements.description: Finish the daily puzzle numbered 100 or later.

achievements.label: Wide Open
achievements.description: Win a Wide or Big Sky puzzle.
